name: Can skylights cause leaks?
description: Properly installed skylights should not leak, but faulty installation, degraded seals, or extreme weather can cause issues.

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly installed skylights are designed to be leak-proof. However, leaks can occur if the installation is faulty, if the flashing or seals degrade over time, or due to severe weather conditions. Using high-quality materials and professional installation are critical for preventing leaks. A first-party insight we've gained from years of experience is that the quality of flashing and its integration with the existing roofing material are the most frequent points of failure; thus, we prioritize these details during every installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Properly installed skylights should not leak, but faulty installation, degraded seals, or extreme weather can cause issues.
